label: Core Concepts
desc: 24 interview questions covering Fundamentals, Schemas, Comparison, Workflow and more.

subs.label: Fundamentals
subs.desc: Apache Avro is an open-source project that offers data serialization as well as data exchange services for Apache Hadoop.

subs.label: Schemas
subs.desc: Avro schemas are created in the "lightweight text-based data interchange" format, JSON (JavaScript Object Notation).

subs.label: Comparison
subs.desc: How does Avro compare to Thrift and Protocol Buffers? What is the advantage of Hadoop's Writable serialization over Java serialization?

subs.label: Workflow
subs.desc: The typical workflow: first create schemas, then read those schemas into your program — which is possible in two ways, either by generating a class corresponding to the schema or by using the parser library directly.

subs.label: Data Types
subs.desc: What primitive data types does Avro support? What complex data types does Avro support?

subs.label: Trade-offs
subs.desc: What are the advantages of Avro? What are the disadvantages of Avro?

subs.label: Security
subs.desc: SASL (Simple Authentication and Security Layer) offers a framework for authentication and security of network protocols.
